card.name: "Until" after stop-the-drug instructions
card.fires_on: The word "until" (sometimes "or" or "that") right after a drug name in an instruction to interrupt or discontinue the drug when a reaction is suspected.

modes.label: Until after drug name
modes.description: "until" follows a product name after discontinue or interrupt, before the condition that must be ruled out or resolved.
modes.example: If signs or symptoms of SCARs occur, interrupt VIJOICE<< until>> the etiology of the reaction has been

modes.label: Other linking words
modes.description: "or" or "that" links treatment, withdrawal or tapering clauses in warnings.
modes.example: This may occur during treatment<< or>> upon withdrawal of the topical corticoster

card.plain: It marks the spot in a warning where a drug is stopped until a problem is cleared up.
